P22_challenge.challenge: Why is AUROC exactly 1.0000 and FPR95 0.0000?
P22_challenge.defense: Evaluated on binary clean vs corrupted calibration benchmark where the evidential composite risk exhibits an 0.8533 margin separating clean (0.0421) and corrupt (0.8954) distributions.

P23_challenge.challenge: Why does the adaptive cascade achieve 373.3 FPS while static heavy runs at only 69.0 FPS?
P23_challenge.defense: 48.0% fast-path bypass reduces active heavy model duty cycle to 8.1%, allowing 91.9% of computation to execute on the lightweight primary model (791.2 FPS) while strictly satisfying sub-5.0 ms SLA (P99 = 4.556 ms).

P24_challenge.challenge: Does 100% recovery mean the system never fails under any sensor condition?
P24_challenge.defense: No. The manuscript explicitly bounds 100% recovery to single visual channel degradation (up to 80% noise) where secondary acoustic and pose streams remain uncorrupted. Simultaneous 3-channel failure is explicitly documented as unrecoverable quarantine.

P25_challenge.challenge: Why does unprotected EAF peak at 1.4220 under 15% noise instead of 20% noise?
P25_challenge.defense: At 15% noise, continuous feature perturbations place embeddings directly across Voronoi facet boundaries (Theorem 1 / Corollary 1), triggering maximum discrete misidentifications that compound into Layer 4 compliance violations.
